answer_1.quote: We propose a task of proactive response selection for single-turn help-seeking conversations in English.

answer_2.quote: We report the average Precision@1 and nDCG@3 on the test splits.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three crowd workers per example with the reward of $0.25/each and asked them to pick an appropriate response candidate
answer_4.guideline: rate all response candidates on a three-point Likert scale (Bad, Acceptable, or Best)
